verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਰੈ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਨ ਕਾਨਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pragaT sa(n)saar bibichaar karai ganikaa pai taeh log bedh ar giaan kee na kaan hai ||

en.bdb: A whore openly commits vice with other men. She has no regard and respect for the morality or code of conduct as laid down in social and religious books.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਛਾਡਿ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਇ ਲਾਛਨੁ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਕੁਲ ਅੰਕੁਸ ਨ ਮਾਨਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kulaa badhoo chhaadd bharataar aan dhuaar jai laachhan lagaavai kul a(n)kus na maan hai ||

en.bdb: But if a lady of respectable family goes to another man tarnishes the image of her family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਬਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਾਨ ਸਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਛਾਡੈ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kapaT sanehee bag dhiaan maan sar firai maanasar chhaaddai ha(n)s ba(n)s mai agiaan hai ||

en.bdb: An egret with false love in his heart wanders from one pond to the other. But if someone belonging to the family of swans (Sikh of the Guru) leaves the Mansarover lake like congregation of the True Guru, that ignorant person is a big fool.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਲੇਪ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੯੦॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh manmukh dhuramat gurmat par tan dhan lep niralep dhiaan hai ||490||

en.bdb: An obedient Sikh of the True Guru engrosses his mind in the consecrated words of wisdom of the True Guru, keeps himself unsullied by the evils of others' wealth and body unlike those with base wisdom who suffer separation from the True Guru. (490)
